mathematical_meanings: Left image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label where the x and h axes meet). Right image: O names the origin of the coordinate axes (the label at the coordinate origin marked by an open circle).
Rationales: In both images, O names the origin of the coordinate axes. The relevant locations are the label where the x and h axes meet on the left and the label at the coordinate origin marked by an open circle on the right.
